title: Feng Mengbo: Long March Restart 冯梦波: 长征 重启
description: Landmark playable videogame artwork across two giant screens remixing the Long March, Street Fighter and Coca-Cola; plus three Now or Never-commissioned arcade games in the foyer.
why_dean: Interactive, game-based AV art from a pioneering Chinese artist — free, drop in any time.

title: Play On – microgames arcade
description: Walk-in arcade of three commissioned microgames by local developers.
why_dean: Local interactive art; closes 31 Jan so go early.

title: Boonwurrung Environmental Soundscapes (in "ngiyama mirrim baany yulendj")
venue: Bunjilaka Aboriginal Cultural Centre, Melbourne Museum
organiser: Melbourne Museum / slow things (Chuan Khoo) / Jordan Lacey

artists.name: Boonwurrung knowledge holders incl. N'arwee't Carolyn Briggs

description: 8-channel interactive soundscape: visitors standing under light cones re-mix Boonwurrung Country flora/fauna recordings.
why_dean: Interactive spatial sound installation — pair with Nocturnal (4 Feb).
date_note: Runs "Sept 2026 – Apr 2027"; exact start/end days not published (1 Sep / 30 Apr used as placeholders).

title: Passage: The Art of Atong Atem
venue: The Ian Potter Centre: NGV Australia, Fed Square
description: First major solo show of the Naarm photographer — performative self-portraiture with paint, textile and Afrofuturist staging.
why_dean: Local performative photography; free and central.

title: a/part: Hoda Afshar (with Vernon Ah Kee & Behrouz Boochani)
venue: Buxton Contemporary, Southbank Blvd & Dodds St
description: "Code Black/Riot" reconfigured as an 8-channel immersive video and sound installation on detention and institutional power.
why_dean: The strongest immersive AV installation in town this summer, by a Naarm artist.

title: daisy, Nicholas Currie, Wila Marra Jones & family – West Space Commission

artists.name: daisy (queer Koorie artist: noise, data, installation, performance)

description: Installation commission by an artist whose practice fuses noise, data, installation and performance; closes 30 Jan.
why_dean: Exactly the local noise/performance/installation crossover Dean likes — catch it before 30 Jan.

title: Lifelike: Puppets, Movies & Magic
description: World-premiere exhibition of movie puppetry and animatronics with hands-on puppetry and a horror room.
why_dean: Interactive and fun, but Hollywood-centred — lower priority.

title: Catherine Bell: Outlier
description: Survey of the Naarm artist incl. 1990s performance videos, socially engaged care/death projects and The Two Cathies collaboration (robot dog!).
why_dean: Local performance-video and socially engaged practice survey.

title: Fifteen Views by Japanese Women Photographers

artists.name: Ishiuchi Miyako, Kawauchi Rinko, Ninagawa Mika, Okanoue Toshiko, Shiga Lieko and 10 others

description: 100+ photographs, video and photobooks by 15 Japanese women photographers from the 1950s to now.
why_dean: Major Asian photography/video survey; a trek to Narre Warren but worth it.

title: Light Weight (TarraWarra summer exhibition)

artists.name: Collection-led, curated by Dr Emily Cormack

description: Collection-led summer show on "the weight of light".
why_dean: Low fit; only if heading to the Yarra Valley anyway.

title: Kent Monkman: Miss Chief's Picture Show
venue: ACCA (Australian Centre for Contemporary Art), 111 Sturt St
description: First Australian survey of Monkman's video and performance practice, centred on his gender-fluid alter ego Miss Chief Eagle Testickle.
why_dean: Video/performance-heavy show; not regional but a strong live-art lineage.

title: NGV Triennial 2026
description: ~100 artists from 35 countries across all four levels of NGV International, incl. strong South/SE Asian and First Nations representation and several immersive video/sound installations.
why_dean: Free anchor show for the whole window; prioritise Kawita Vatanajyankur, Maria Madeira, Shilpa Gupta, Wu Tsang and Xu Tiantian.

title: Interrupt Festival 2027 (chiptune & live hardware electronics)
description: Three nights of chiptune, trackers and custom hardware rigs plus daytime hardware workshops.
why_dean: Hardware/live-electronics niche; site is sparse on ticketing, so verify before planning.

title: NGV Friday Nights: TRIENNIAL
description: Ticketed after-hours Triennial access with music.
why_dean: Easy night-time way to see the Triennial; lineup TBC.

title: Overmono – live AV show
venue: PICA (Port Melbourne Industrial Centre for the Arts)
description: Only Melbourne headline show: full audiovisual live production in the PICA warehouse.
why_dean: Big club-AV production; European and commercial-ish, so lower on Dean's list.

title: Make It Up Club (weekly improvised & sound-art night)

artists.name: Rotating Naarm improvisers and sound artists

description: Melbourne's long-running weekly avant-garde improv/sound night; 12 & 19 Jan 2027 listed, later Tuesdays expected.
why_dean: The steady weekly base of the local experimental-sound scene (@makeitupclub in Dean's graph).
date_note: Weekly on Tuesdays; 12 and 19 Jan 2027 are listed on Oztix, later dates expected (31 Mar end is a window, not a listing).

title: Glenn Walls: Everything is going to be ok? (MPavilion)
description: Tracing Melbourne's forgotten queer landscapes of connection and loss.
why_dean: One-day MPavilion presentation; minor.

title: Midsumma Festival 2027: "Shifting Sands"

artists.name: 200+ LGBTQIA+ artists; curatorial theme centres queer voices across Australia, Asia and the South Pacific

description: 22-day queer arts festival; 2027 theme "Shifting Sands" explicitly focuses on queer life across Australia, Asia and the South Pacific.
why_dean: The umbrella for most Jan–Feb live/performance art; this year's Asia-Pacific curatorial lens is squarely Dean's brief.

title: Midsumma Art Award 2027 exhibition
description: Finalists exhibition of Australia's leading queer art prize.
why_dean: Quick survey of queer contemporary art; low effort add-on.

title: BEGIN TO BE
description: Contemporary circus, dance and physical theatre with projected cosmic imagery.
why_dean: Projection-heavy physical performance; cheap.

title: Triennial EXTRA (late nights)

artists.name: Lineup TBA (2024 edition featured Sui Zhen, Mindy Meng Wang, C.FRIM etc.)

description: Ten free after-hours nights of music, DJs, performance, dance and talks inside the Triennial; dates set, program not yet announced.
why_dean: Historically books exactly Dean's kind of local AV/experimental acts; watch for lineup drop in December.

title: Digital Fantasy – Chira Grasby
description: Oil painting on circuit boards, lo-fi video and ceramics mining Y2K internet culture and adolescence online.
why_dean: Lo-fi video + internet-culture work by a local artist.

title: Soft Static (queer group exhibition)
description: Group show across painting, installation, new media, photography and textile exploring "static" — noise, interference and softness.
why_dean: Big survey of emerging local queer artists, including new media.

title: The Night Flower
description: One-hour solo experimental work of music, poetry, clowning and performance art on neurodivergence, queerness and womanhood.
why_dean: Small-room solo performance art from an emerging local maker.

title: Reflector: A Double Bill – Scimm. Dance
description: Contemporary dance double bill on identity, intimacy and the gaze — one high-fashion and visually hypnotic, one raw.
why_dean: Contemporary dance at Dancehouse; secondary fit.

title: Focus on Queer 中文 Cinema (ACMI × Midsumma)

artists.name: Tsai Ming-liang ("Days"), Yau Ching ("Let's Love Hong Kong"), Stanley Kwan ("Lan Yu") and others

description: Season of queer Chinese-language film from China, Taiwan and Hong Kong incl. Tsai Ming-liang's "Days" and Yau Ching's experimental "Let's Love Hong Kong".
why_dean: East Asian moving-image work; "Let's Love Hong Kong" (27 Jan, 5 Feb) is the experimental pick.
date_note: Individual films screen on set dates, e.g. Days 22 Jan; Let's Love Hong Kong 27 Jan & 5 Feb; Lan Yu 24 & 31 Jan.

title: Lanterns of Pride (queer Lunar New Year)
description: New Lunar New Year celebration for LGBTQIAPN+ Asian communities and families.
why_dean: Asian-diaspora queer community event.

title: Soft Static – opening night (live performance, DJs, interactive art)

artists.name: 35+ queer artists across new media, installation, textile etc.

description: Ticketed opening of a 35+ artist queer group show "between noise and softness", with live performance, DJs and interactive art.
why_dean: Multi-format DIY-scale night: performance + DJs + interactive work in a studio complex.

title: The Body Language Project
description: Collaborative portraiture project on expansive gender expression, with performance and talks.
why_dean: Community-made portrait/performance project; minor pick.

title: Fekei
description: Rotuman lesbian love story built around fekei (a Rotuman pudding) and the clash of love and tradition.
why_dean: Pasifika queer storytelling at Next Wave's home base.

title: Wasted Light – Ronan Apcar & Po Goh (two pianos)
venue: Melbourne Recital Centre – Primrose Potter Salon
description: Two-piano program of queer composers including a rare Julius Eastman performance.
why_dean: Eastman = minimalist/experimental canon, played by local pianists.

title: First Nations Drag Showcase (hosted by 2JOOCEE)
venue: Pride of our Footscray Community Bar, 86–88 Hopkins St

artists.name: 2JOOCEE and five First Nations drag/cabaret/dance artists

description: Performances and conversations by queer First Nations creatives.
why_dean: Community-scale First Nations performance night in the west.

title: House of Diesel | THH – Vogue Night
description: Warehouse vogue night.
why_dean: DIY warehouse ballroom night.

title: Temple After Dark

artists.name: All-queer and trans cast of artists of colour (creators of Temple of Desire)

description: Late-night performance/club hybrid: sensual dance, gender-defiant burlesque and euphoric performance by queer and trans artists of colour.
why_dean: Performance that bleeds into a club night, centring local artists of colour.

title: WERK: SERVE with Aysha Buffet
venue: ACCA (Australian Centre for Contemporary Art), 111 Sturt St
description: One-night "living exhibition" of drag and queer performance inside ACCA, alongside the Kent Monkman show; 18+.
why_dean: Free live-art night in a contemporary gallery, curated by a local trans drag artist.

title: Digital Narratives
description: First Nations exhibition asking whether Indigenous futures can be digitised — oral tradition, code, data centres and Country.
why_dean: Tech/digital-themed First Nations show running right through the window.

title: Joy Stations – Slow Art Collective & Lichen Kelp
description: Pop-up hands-on stations of colour, flowers, sound and everyday objects on queer joy; all ages.
why_dean: Participatory, sound-inclusive work by a respected local collective and sound artist.

title: The Fantasy Ball II: Strictly Business – House of Furia
description: Ballroom spectacular with categories, voguing and battles.
why_dean: Ballroom = live performance with audience energy; local scene staple.

title: Dancehouse Season 1 2027 (expected)
description: Dancehouse says 2027 Season 1 runs February–April; works not yet published.
why_dean: Independent experimental dance; check announcements.
date_note: Dancehouse states Season 1 runs Feb–Apr 2027; specific works/dates TBA.

title: Darebin Speakeasy 2027 Presentation Season (expected)
description: Season of new theatre, dance, circus and live art at Northcote Town Hall; selections not yet public. Window shown is a guess — Speakeasy seasons run through the year.
why_dean: Independent live art at NTH; unannounced.
date_note: Window is a guess; season not announced.

title: Liquid Architecture early-2027 program (expected)
venue: Various (LA is based at Collingwood Yards)

artists.name: Recurring series: Inter.Sonix (SE Asian/Asia-Pacific sound), L(i)quid Listening, Poly-Rhythmic; partners Nongkrong, BLINDSIDE

description: 2027 program not yet listed (latest is 6 Dec 2026). In 2026 LA curated a live A/V night at Arts House in Feb and Inter.Sonix ran from May. Dates are an estimate.
why_dean: Core org for SE Asian experimental sound in Naarm; subscribe to the newsletter.
date_note: Estimated window; 2027 program not yet published.

title: Electric Fields with the Australian Queer Orchestra
venue: Arts Centre Melbourne – Ian Potter State Theatre
organiser: CMA with Arts Centre Melbourne & Midsumma
description: Electric Fields' electronic/Anangu-language songs with orchestra; premieres "Kiss Your Tears".
why_dean: Pairs with Fielding's Inma Ungu at ACCA in March.

title: Nocturnal – Pride edition
description: After-dark museum opening with DJ, talks and tours; also the chance to catch the interactive "Boonwurrung Environmental Soundscapes" in Bunjilaka.
why_dean: Low-key night; pair with the Bunjilaka sound installation.

title: Open Air at the Square 2027 (free music & screen season)
description: Five weeks of free live music and outdoor cinema; The Necks are also billed (date to check on Fed Square program).
why_dean: Free; The Necks and Drifting Clouds are the relevant picks.
date_note: Season dates confirmed; The Necks' specific Open Air date not shown in the season copy.

title: Soft Nights at NCM
description: After-hours queer night in the "Radical Computing" exhibition — slow/tender tech, bedazzle a floppy disc, creative coding vibes.
why_dean: Playful interactive tech-art night.

title: Homophonic! – new music by queer composers
description: New-music concert program incl. the RESPECT commissions about regional queer pioneers.
why_dean: Contemporary composition; secondary.

title: Jonny Woo: SUBURBIA
description: Performance art/storytelling memoir from the London alt-drag figure.
why_dean: Live-art lineage (London alt-cabaret), though European.

title: Purple Plastic Māori – Shalom Kaa
description: Award-winning autobiographical queer Māori cabaret ("everybody does the haka").
why_dean: Pacific queer performance; cabaret rather than live art.

title: SUN CUT: a lover's dictionary
description: Durational come-and-go dance work: a living lexicon of 366 gestures embodying Wittig & Zeig's "Lesbian Peoples: Materials for a Dictionary".
why_dean: Durational, come-and-go live-art format — closest Midsumma analogue to an Aphids-style endurance work.

title: Cowboy C*untry with Kath Ebbs
description: Interactive queer line-dancing "rodeo".
why_dean: Participatory/interactive performance; light fun.

title: NGV Triennial × Midsumma: Queer Reflections
description: Queer creatives respond to selected Triennial works.
why_dean: Free; easy add-on to a Triennial visit.

title: Nongkrong: Pasar Senja (twilight fair)
description: Indonesian-Australian collective's dusk fair: dangdut, Indonesian experimental jazz, gamelan, art market, screen-printing; on Imlek/eve of Ramadan.
why_dean: Local SE Asian diaspora collective (also Liquid Architecture & Asia TOPA collaborators).

title: ark 022 // LLEAHDAVIES + ?????
description: Overnight multi-room party; each room "programmed around its own identity", dark and hazed, phone cameras covered.
why_dean: Environment-designed, no-phones club night — atmospheric if not strictly art.

title: Heartland – Emily Dynes (shown at Pride Street Party)
description: Magic-realist collaborative portraits of queer regional life, shown at Victoria's Pride Street Party.
why_dean: Public-art component of the street party.

title: Melbourne Chinatown Lunar New Year Festival
description: Street festival with lion dances and performances on Little Bourke St.
why_dean: Community festival — low art fit but on the Asia-Pacific calendar (clashes with Pride Street Party).

title: Victoria's Pride Street Party
description: Midsumma closing street party on Gertrude & Smith Sts with stages and Heartland portraits.
why_dean: Party/closing event; clashes with Chinatown LNY.

title: Arts House Season 1 2027 (expected)
venue: Arts House, North Melbourne Town Hall, 521 Queensberry St

artists.name: Possible: 2026–27 CultureLAB artists incl. Nikki Lam ("Fish, Ghost, Goddess" moving image/performance, Naarm/HK), Emma McManus ("Mating Dance"), Rawcus, Jodee Mundy, Kush Kuiy

description: Season 1 2026 ran 12 Feb–29 Mar (Pey Chi, Rel Pham, Mindy Meng Wang & Monica Lim, Liquid Architecture-curated live A/V); a similar Feb–Mar 2027 season is expected but unannounced. Dates are an estimate.
why_dean: Historically the single best venue for Dean's brief (Asian-Australian live art + AV). Watch for announcement.
date_note: Estimated from Season 1 2026 (12 Feb–29 Mar). Not announced.

title: Essential Tension (Potter Museum reopening)
venue: Potter Museum of Art, University of Melbourne

artists.name: Co-curated by Hannah Presley & Debbie Pryor

description: Potter reopens 12 Feb 2027 with "Essential Tension" (Feb–June 2027); exact end date not published.
why_dean: New curated show; details still thin — check closer to date.
date_note: Reopens 12 Feb 2027; runs "February to June 2027" — end day not published (30 Jun placeholder).

title: Box Hill Chinese New Year Festival
description: Large suburban Lunar New Year street festival.
why_dean: Low art fit.

title: East Meets West Lunar New Year Festival (Footscray)
description: Footscray's Vietnamese/SE Asian-centred Lunar New Year festival; 2027 date not yet confirmed (dates shown are a placeholder for the weekend after Lunar New Year).
why_dean: SE Asian community festival in the west; low art fit.
date_note: 2027 date not yet confirmed by Maribyrnong; dates shown are a placeholder.

title: Silent Cinema with Live Scores (Open Air at the Square)
organiser: Fed Square (Open Air at the Square)

artists.name: The New Pollutants (live score to Metropolis, 18 Feb)
Live DJ score to Phantom of the Opera (15–16 Feb)

description: Week of silent classics on the big screen with original live scores, incl. Metropolis' 100th anniversary.
why_dean: Free outdoor live-scored cinema = accessible AV.

title: ON&ON Festival (street dance)

artists.name: Cypher Culture and Melbourne street-dance crews

description: Six days of street-dance battles, workshops, talks and performances.
why_dean: Live local dance culture; secondary fit.

title: ACMI Experimental Forum (experimental video & performance crit)

artists.name: Rotating guest artists; Dec 2026 session featured Sekar Sari (Indonesia/Naarm)

description: Monthly art-school-style crit of experimental video/performance works-in-development; ACMI lists the run to 17 Feb 2027 (a January session is likely but undated).
why_dean: Best way to meet emerging local video/performance makers; free.
date_note: ACMI lists the series as running to 17 Feb 2027; a January session is likely but undated.

title: CARRION – Savier D'Arsie-Marquez
description: Punk-rock, anti-establishment pitch-black comedy about family and inheritance.
why_dean: Indie local theatre with a punk edge; secondary.

title: Hotel Pro Forma – OPERATION:ORFEO (visual opera)
venue: Arts Centre Melbourne – Ian Potter State Theatre
organiser: Arts Centre Melbourne & Arts Projects Australia
description: 1993 landmark "visual opera in three movements": image, light and choral voice instead of narrative, with John Cage excerpts.
why_dean: Image/light/sound-driven performance — a European classic of the expanded-theatre form.

title: Melbourne Art Fair 2027 (incl. VIDEO sector)

artists.name: 80+ galleries; VIDEO curated by Matthew Hanson (Artspace Aotearoa)
Chun Yin Rainbow Chan (solo, MARS Gallery)
Victorian First Peoples Art & Design Fair

description: 20th edition; VIDEO sector of moving-image installations, live performances and BEYOND commissions (names TBA).
why_dean: VIDEO sector + performance program are the draw; commercial otherwise.

title: Karla Dickens: You're Not the Centre of the Universe
venue: Monash University Museum of Art (MUMA), 900 Dandenong Rd
description: First major Melbourne exhibition of Dickens' assemblages; puts First Nations knowledge at the centre of the climate emergency, with a major new commission.
why_dean: Dean's own campus museum; strong installation-led First Nations show.

title: St Kilda Festival 2027
description: Free foreshore music festival; mostly mainstream Australian music.
why_dean: Low fit — listed only for side programming.

title: The Necks at The Substation
description: Long-form improvised piano-trio sets reopening The Substation for 2027.
why_dean: Sun 21 Feb SOLD OUT; Mon 22 Feb has more tickets released — book now.

title: Brunswick Music Festival 2027
description: Week-long Merri-bek festival; program not yet announced. New programmer El Chantry (ex-MRC contemporary programmer, ex-Gertrude St Projection Festival).
why_dean: New programmer with a projection/experimental background — watch for program (likely Jan).

title: Gold Mountain Wives 金山婆
description: New musical on Chinese-Australian history under exclusion — "what does it take to make a home in a country determined to exclude you?"
why_dean: Asian-Australian new work at La Mama in its 60th year.

title: Mo H. Zareei (mHz): Public Relations
description: Exhibition by the NZ-based sound/AV artist behind the "Cruise Missile Intersectionality" A/V set.
why_dean: Sound-sculpture/AV exhibition that pairs with the Tim Hecker + mHz opening night.

title: Pitch Music & Arts 2027 (10th edition)
description: Four-day electronic camping festival in Gariwerd with art installations; clashes with Golden Plains weekend.
why_dean: Cloudy and Tangerine from Dean's post-club graph play; site-specific art installs.

title: Tim Hecker + mHz (A/V "Cruise Missile Intersectionality")
description: Hecker's saturated ambient live set plus mHz's political A/V work, in the Substation's turbine hall; haze and strobe.
why_dean: The clearest high-end AV/experimental gig of the window, co-presented with Soft Centre (in Dean's graph).

title: Golden Plains Nineteen
description: Single-stage camping festival; ballot already drawn.
why_dean: Mainly for Rydeen & SOVBLKPSSY (in Dean's graph) — resale only now.

title: Leyla Stevens: A Song Foretold
venue: ACCA (Australian Centre for Contemporary Art), 111 Sturt St
description: Solo show of moving image, photography, performance lineages and sculpture drawing on Balinese archives and counter-histories.
why_dean: Top-tier SE Asian moving-image/performance practice, newly Naarm-based; opens inside the window.

title: Zaachariaha Fielding: Inma Ungu
venue: ACCA (Australian Centre for Contemporary Art), 111 Sturt St
description: Major commission turning ACCA into an immersive painted landscape (walls, floors, canvases) grounded in Inma — ceremony, song and dance.
why_dean: Expansive, immersive installation; pairs with Electric Fields at Midsumma.

title: ENCLAVE – Eliza Dune Daiza
description: Verse drama set in a remote commune of punishment, control and identity erasure.
why_dean: Formally unusual local theatre; secondary.

title: Arts House: Local Encounters Community Weekend
venue: Arts House & sites across North and West Melbourne

artists.name: Up to 8 Lab artists (announced 14 Dec 2026); facilitated by Madeleine Flynn & Lana Nguyen

description: Public talks, workshops and events where Lab artists share participatory, place-responsive propositions for North/West Melbourne.
why_dean: Participatory/site-specific live art in development — the Arts House end of the Aphids spectrum.

title: TarraWarra International 2027: Under the Same Sky
organiser: TarraWarra Museum of Art × Jehangir Nicholson Art Foundation (Mumbai)

artists.name: Shilpa Gupta, Mithu Sen, Gauri Gill, Sohrab Hura, Simryn Gill, Khadim Ali, Munem Wasif, Kirtika Kain, Amol Patil and others

description: Joint Australia–Mumbai exhibition of South Asian and diasporic artists across film, installation and performance.
why_dean: Big South Asian/diaspora show with performance artists like Mithu Sen and Amol Patil; opens in the last fortnight of the window.
